title: Map Optimizations: Yesod
description: Port of uGuardian's Map Optimizations: Yesod (Workshop 2798869790) as host callbacks on observation gates: the gear sparks, background smoke and screen sparks of Yesod's floor can each be switched off. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Map Optimizations: Yesod
launcher.note: Several optimization improvements to Yesod’s Floor. Original mod by [uGuardian’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2798869790)

settings.label: Gear sparks
settings.note: The sparks of the turning gears. Off saves the most.

settings.label: Background smoke
settings.note: The smoke on the ground of the floor.

settings.label: Screen sparks
settings.note: The sparks that fly across the screen.
